outline: 先修課程：3002012或負責教授同意。介紹各種不同分析方法（如能量法及Castigliano定理）、破壞理論、材料選用、可靠度概念、軸及軸承、離合器及煞車器、傳動元件(如皮帶、鏈條、齒輪)、軸聯接器、飛輪、彈簧等。
schedule:
1. Introduction to Mechanical Design
2. Materials
3. Load and Stress Analysis
4. Load and Stress Analysis
5. Deflection and Stiffness
6. Deflection and Stiffness
7. Failures Resulting from Static Loading
8. Failures Resulting from Static Loading
9. 期中考
10.Fatigue Failure Resulting from Variable Loading
11.Fatigue Failure Resulting from Variable Loading
12.Fatigue Failure Resulting from Variable Loading
13.Shaft design
14.Screws, Fasteners, and Design of Nonpermanent Joints
15.Screws, Fasteners, and Design of Nonpermanent Joints
14.Design of Mechanical Springs
15.Design of Mechanical Springs
16.Gear design
17.Flexible Mechanical elements
18.期末考
assessment: 35% Midterm test, 35% Final test, 30% 平時成績
